summary: Delivery audit of the whole PRD (20 criteria, four rounds): 7 criteria are not fully built. After Start, names are reached one at a time, and a folder name can reach a repository found by search. Several screens and terminal lines show Kiln's internal name instead of the label, and the saved short name is lost on Folder missing and continuation restarts. A reset page asks while other start checks fail. The terminal skips the locate line without a browser. Start's note isn't amber, and the paused page places the question below the ways to resolve the stop. Phases 3 and 4 build them. AC-FIND-02 was amended to match the technical design's choice to search a starting folder that is itself a checkout. The fourth round still found a new gap.
